name: Profit & Lost Report (P&L)
sql_query:
WITH pl AS (
    -- ── Revenue ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    SELECT 10 AS sort_order, 'Revenue' AS section, 'Sales' AS particulars,
           COALESCE(SUM(s.Net_Amount), 0) AS amount
    FROM t_invoice_sums s
    WHERE s.BC = :bc AND s.Invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 11, 'Revenue', 'Less: Sales Returns', -COALESCE(SUM(r.net_amount), 0)
    FROM t_sales_return_sums r
    WHERE r.BC = :bc AND r.return_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 12, 'Revenue', 'Hire Purchase Sales', COALESCE(SUM(h.net_amount), 0)
    FROM t_hire_purchase_sums h
    WHERE h.BC = :bc AND h.invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to AND h.is_opening = 0

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 13, 'Revenue', 'Less: Hire Purchase Returns', -COALESCE(SUM(hr.net_amount), 0)
    FROM t_hire_purchase_return_sums hr
    WHERE hr.bc = :bc AND hr.return_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    -- ── Cost of sales (purchase price of the batch sold, else the item's standard cost) ──
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 20, 'Cost of Sales', 'Cost of Goods Sold - Sales',
           -COALESCE(SUM(d.QTY * COALESCE(ib.purchase_price, i.standard_purchase_price, 0)), 0)
    FROM t_invoice_deils d
    JOIN t_invoice_sums s     ON s.Invoice_no = d.Invoice_no
    LEFT JOIN items i         ON i.item_code  = d.Item_code
    LEFT JOIN item_batches ib ON ib.batch_no = d.batch_no AND ib.item_code = d.Item_code AND ib.store_id = d.store_id
    WHERE s.BC = :bc AND s.Invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 21, 'Cost of Sales', 'Less: Cost of Sales Returns',
           COALESCE(SUM(rd.qty * COALESCE(ib.purchase_price, i.standard_purchase_price, 0)), 0)
    FROM t_sales_return_details rd
    JOIN t_sales_return_sums r ON r.return_no = rd.return_no
    LEFT JOIN items i          ON i.item_code = rd.item_code
    LEFT JOIN item_batches ib  ON ib.batch_no = rd.batch_no AND ib.item_code = rd.item_code AND ib.store_id = rd.store_id
    WHERE r.BC = :bc AND r.return_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 22, 'Cost of Sales', 'Cost of Goods Sold - Hire Purchase',
           -COALESCE(SUM(d.qty * COALESCE(ib.purchase_price, i.standard_purchase_price, 0)), 0)
    FROM t_hire_purchase_details d
    JOIN t_hire_purchase_sums h ON h.invoice_no = d.invoice_no
    LEFT JOIN items i           ON i.item_code  = d.item_code
    LEFT JOIN item_batches ib   ON ib.batch_no = d.batch_no AND ib.item_code = d.item_code AND ib.store_id = d.store_id
    WHERE h.BC = :bc AND h.invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to AND h.is_opening = 0

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 23, 'Cost of Sales', 'Less: Cost of Hire Purchase Returns',
           COALESCE(SUM(rd.qty * COALESCE(ib.purchase_price, i.standard_purchase_price, 0)), 0)
    FROM t_hire_purchase_return_details rd
    JOIN t_hire_purchase_return_sums hr ON hr.hpreturn_code = rd.hpreturn_code
    LEFT JOIN items i                   ON i.item_code = rd.item_code
    LEFT JOIN item_batches ib           ON ib.batch_no = rd.batch_no AND ib.item_code = rd.item_code AND ib.store_id = rd.store_id
    WHERE hr.bc = :bc AND hr.return_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    -- ── Other income: every Income account except Sales Income (taken from documents above) ──
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 40, 'Other Income', a.description, SUM(t.cr_amount - t.dr_amount)
    FROM t_account_trans t
    JOIN m_chartof_accounts a    ON a.code = t.AccCode
    JOIN m_main_account_types ty ON ty.id  = a.type_id
    JOIN m_main_categories mc    ON mc.id  = ty.category_id
    WHERE t.BC = :bc AND t.Ddate BETWEEN :from AND :to
      AND mc.name = 'Income' AND t.AccCode <> '4002'
    GROUP BY a.code, a.description

    -- ── Expenses: every Expenses account ──
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 50, 'Expenses', a.description, -SUM(t.dr_amount - t.cr_amount)
    FROM t_account_trans t
    JOIN m_chartof_accounts a    ON a.code = t.AccCode
    JOIN m_main_account_types ty ON ty.id  = a.type_id
    JOIN m_main_categories mc    ON mc.id  = ty.category_id
    WHERE t.BC = :bc AND t.Ddate BETWEEN :from AND :to
      AND mc.name = 'Expenses'
    GROUP BY a.code, a.description
)
SELECT section, particulars, amount, subtotal
FROM (
    SELECT sort_order, section, particulars, amount, NULL AS subtotal FROM pl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 30, 'Gross Profit', 'Gross Profit', NULL, SUM(amount) FROM pl WHERE sort_order < 30
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 45, 'Other Income', 'Total Other Income', NULL, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pl WHERE sort_order = 40
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 55, 'Expenses', 'Total Expenses', NULL, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM pl WHERE sort_order = 50
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 60, 'Net Profit', CASE WHEN SUM(amount) >= 0 THEN 'Net Profit' ELSE 'Net Loss' END, NULL, SUM(amount) FROM pl
) statement
ORDER BY sort_order, particulars;
